```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", eval = FALSE)
```

Each predator in the dashboard gets a card with a photo and a short
description. `dv_species_card_assets()` finds those for one predator and
returns the photo as a data URI, so the dashboard stays a single file. Cards
exist for predators only; prey have no cards. The chunks here are shown but not
run, because they read or download image files.

## Where the photo comes from

DietView takes the first photo it finds, in this order:

1. a local file you name in `species_info`;
2. a local file in `image_dir` named after the predator (`atlantic_cod.jpg`);
3. a local file in `image_dir` named after its Latin name (`gadus_morhua.jpg`);
4. with `photo_source = "inaturalist"`, a photo of the taxon on
   [iNaturalist](https://www.inaturalist.org/), if its license is one you
   accept;
5. with `photo_source = "wikipedia"`, a Wikimedia Commons file you name, or the
   image of the Wikipedia article, if it is hosted on Commons.

The default, `photo_source = "none"`, never goes online. You can name both
online sources, tried in the order given:
`photo_source = c("inaturalist", "wikipedia")` uses Wikimedia Commons only for
predators with no acceptable photo on iNaturalist.

The description is the text you give in `species_info`. Otherwise, with either
online source, it is the summary of the taxon's Wikipedia article (iNaturalist
returns the same summary). Wikipedia text is under CC BY-SA, so the card
credits it under the description. If a network lookup fails, the card is built
without that element.

## Photos from iNaturalist

iNaturalist photos belong to the observers who took them, and each one carries
its own license. DietView looks the predator up by its Latin name, keeps only
a taxon whose name matches it, and tries the taxon's default photo first, then
its other photos, until one has a license you accept.

```{r inat}
library(DietView)

asset <- dv_species_card_assets(
  predator = "Atlantic cod", latin = "Gadus morhua",
  photo_source = "inaturalist",
  image_dir = "images")        # a permanent folder keeps the photos

asset$credit    # "Photo: <author>, CC BY, via iNaturalist"
asset$author    # the photographer
asset$license   # "CC0", "CC BY" or "CC BY-SA" by default
asset$url       # the photo's page on iNaturalist
```

By default only three licenses are accepted: CC0, CC BY and CC BY-SA. Each one
lets you redistribute the photo inside a dashboard, provided you credit the
author, and for CC BY-SA keep the same license. Photos marked "all rights
reserved" are never used. Many iNaturalist photos are CC BY-NC (no commercial
use); accept them only if every use of the dashboard will be non-commercial:

```{r inat-nc}
dv_build_html(prep, output = "diet_dashboard.html",
              photo_source = "inaturalist",
              licenses = c("cc0", "cc-by", "cc-by-sa", "cc-by-nc"),
              image_dir = "images")
```

The other codes are `"cc-by-nc-sa"`, `"cc-by-nd"` and `"cc-by-nc-nd"`. If no
photo of the taxon has an accepted license, the card has no photo.

On the card, the credit line sits under the photo and links to the photo's
page on iNaturalist. Each downloaded photo is saved in `image_dir` together
with a `.json` file holding its source, author, license and page, so a photo
reused in a later session keeps its credit. To fetch a photo again, delete the
image and its `.json` file.

## Your own photos

With your own photos nothing is fetched. Give the credit fields in
`species_info`, so the card shows them the same way:

```{r offline}
dat <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "dietview_example.csv", package = "DietView"),
                na.strings = c("NA", ""))
lin <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "dietview_example_lineage.csv", package = "DietView"),
                na.strings = c("NA", ""))
spec <- dv_spec(predator = "predator_species_common_name",
                predator_latin = "predator_species_latin_name",
                stomach = "stomach_id", prey_id = "aphia_id",
                prey_name = "verified_name", weight = "prey_weight")
prep <- dv_prepare(dat, spec, taxonomy = "table", lineage = lin, verbose = FALSE)

info <- list(
  "Atlantic cod" = list(
    desc    = "Demersal gadid; feeds on fish and invertebrates.",
    photo   = "images/atlantic_cod.jpg",
    author  = "DFO Gulf Region",
    license = "CC BY"
  ),
  "Winter flounder" = list(
    desc  = "Right-eyed flounder; feeds on polychaetes, bivalves and small crustaceans.",
    photo = "images/winter_flounder.jpg"
  )
)
dv_build_html(prep, output = file.path(tempdir(), "diet_dashboard.html"),
              species_info = info, image_dir = "images")
```

You can also put the credit in a `.json` file next to the image, with the same
name (`images/winter_flounder.json`):

```json
{"author": "Jane Doe", "license": "CC BY",
 "url": "https://www.inaturalist.org/photos/123456"}
```

## Before you share a dashboard

The photos are embedded in the HTML file, so the file keeps working when
`image_dir` is deleted, and it carries the photos wherever it goes. Open the
dashboard and check the credit line on every card. A photo with no credit
line is one you supplied without author or license.
